catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class moves one motion axis by a relative distance in the stage's own unit: cap.motion.joint_position.v1 takes an array of absolute joint positions in rad, cap.motion.cartesian_pose.v1 takes a Cartesian pose, and cap.motion.home.v1 and cap.motion.stop.v1 do not move by a distance; the package declares an inline x-cap input and output

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level); no hardware was attached or run. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the PythonObjectDriver helper, but the package uses a direct Driver over pyAPT.controller:Controller with native.py because the upstream object owns the FTDI transport and the binary APT message sequence, and the stage model is chosen at deployment (MTS50, PRM1 or LTS300). Absolute goto is served as the writable position through cap.device.configure.v1, the relative move as x-cap.freespace.move_relative.v1, home as cap.motion.home.v1 and stop as the safe-state cap.motion.stop.v1; identify, reset_parameters, suspend/resume_end_of_move_messages and request_home_params are not exposed (identify has no observable state, reset_parameters only applies to the BPC30x series, and the other two are transport helpers). No numeric position, maximum velocity, acceleration, relative distance or home speed_scale bound is declared because the stage model is a deployment option and the clone gives a different range per subclass; those inputs are Limit.operator_required and site-limits.example.json is only an example overlay, not a statement about a stage. The stop deceleration input carries no numeric limit: the APT MOVE_STOP message has no deceleration field, a positive value only selects the profiled stop and zero or no value selects the immediate stop, so the number is never sent. The fake is an in-memory stand-in, not a recording: it does not model the FTDI/USB framing, the binary APT messages, motion kinematics, the controller travel-range check or the status bits beyond the values the driver reads, and all of its starting values are marked placeholder. No estop_physical_ref is set because no clone line documents an independent hardware e-stop; the cap.motion.stop.v1 safe-state action is the declarative stop and the @estop sends the native immediate stop. This R1 package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null) and does not claim the loader's R2/R3 unreviewed-backend refusal. Every Fact cites a line of the clone at the pinned commit and the last gate reported no warnings; gate.digest is the digest line printed by that run.
